item.title: Baby Brezza Prowash 360 Giveaway – Baby Brezza

item.description: Prize: A Taylor Jacob Collier GS Mini 5-string guitar, five sets of D'Addario Jacob Collier signature strings, a strap, a Humidipak, merch and the vinyl «The Light for Days» (ARV up to $1,026). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Enter on the giveaway page (no purchase necessary; a qualifying order gives an extra entry). US residents 18+

US excl. NY & FL, 18+
